prompt: On a box plot, the left whisker reaches the ___?
hint: The whiskers are the lines that stick out from the box toward the two ends of the data.

hints.text: The whiskers are the lines that stick out from the box toward the two ends of the data.
The number line increases from left to right, so the left whisker stretches to the smallest value in the data set.
The left whisker reaches the minimum.

explanation: A box plot shows the five-number summary on a number line that increases to the right.
The box covers $Q_1$ to $Q_3$, and the whiskers extend from the box to the extreme values.
The left whisker ends at the smallest value, so it reaches the minimum.
